title: curie <tier> eval --sweep --json
description: The agent-facing payload of a `curie <tier> eval --sweep` run: one row per model. `pass_rate` is null (not a fabricated 0.0) on a never-completed row; `plumbing_only` flags a fixture-only row whose `passed`/`total` carry no graded signal.

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the tar.gz snapshot every runner in the sweep mounted (#1087). Always present; the recorded runner's digest when the skill sweep reused it, the sweep's own ephemeral snapshot digest when it packed one, and null at the local/cluster tiers, which grade a deployed version rather than a locally snapshotted bundle.
